snippet.title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://tinyurl.com/foalaunch
Music by Andrzej Janicki

Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon is out now on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S!
Step into a dark reimagination of Arthurian legends in this first-person, open-world RPG. Explore a world stuck in everlasting autumn, witness falling legends, and make meaningful choices woven into a complex, branching storyline.
#taintedgrail #release #trailer #pc #steam #playstation #xbox
